lines: The stranger in the black car wants one thing... to *save the world*.
In her lab, a screen shows an asteroid. Impact in four hundred days. You solve it in *nine seconds*.
She goes pale. Because your solution works... but it needs one impossible thing.
Every person on Earth must *agree*. At the same time. On anything. You can calculate planets, but never *that*.
So what if the only person who can convince the world... is the friend you scared away?
Follow and comment... for part four!
